scripts.build: npm run build -w @latexllm/compile-service && npm run build -w @latexllm/cloud-summary && npm run build -w @latexllm/ai-panel && npm run build -w @latexllm/server && npm run build -w @latexllm/desktop
scripts.start: npm run build && concurrently -k -n server,desktop "npm start -w @latexllm/server" "npm start -w @latexllm/desktop"
scripts.start:stub: cross-env LTX_STUB_AI=1 LTX_STUB_COMPILE=1 CLOUD_SUMMARY_STUB=1 npm start
scripts.test: npm run test -w @latexllm/compile-service -- --runInBand && npm run test -w @latexllm/cloud-summary && npm run test -w @latexllm/ai-panel && npm run test -w @latexllm/desktop && npm run test -w @latexllm/server
